name: New Year’S Eve Marathon With Reeko
description: Gare Porto hosts a New Year's Eve Marathon featuring Reeko, playing techno, deep techno, and Detroit techno. The event runs from 11:00 PM on December 31st to 6:00 AM the next day.
longDescription:
Gare Porto presents a New Year's Eve Marathon with Reeko, an event focused on electronic music. The lineup features Reeko, who will perform techno, deep techno, and Detroit techno.

The marathon starts on Thursday, December 31st, at 11:00 PM and continues until 6:00 AM. The venue is Gare Porto, located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal.

Tickets are available starting at €15.00 for the first release.

longDescriptionPt:
A Gare Porto apresenta uma Maratona de Ano Novo com Reeko, um evento focado na música eletrónica. O cartaz inclui Reeko, que vai tocar techno, deep techno e Detroit techno.

A maratona começa na quinta-feira, 31 de dezembro, às 23h00 e continua até às 6h00. O local é a Gare Porto, na Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal.

Os bilhetes estão disponíveis a partir de 15,00 € para a primeira fase.
